assertion_results.text: Impact map or task descriptions explicitly flag at least 3 ambiguities from the feature description
assertion_results.evidence: The impact map 'Ambiguities Identified' section lists 5 ambiguities: (1) No performance targets defined, (2) No relevance criteria specified, (3) Filter types unspecified, (4) No definition of 'useful results', (5) Non-functional requirements are vague. All directly reference vague language from the feature description. 5 >= 3.

assertion_results.text: Convention-aware enrichment validates file-type applicability per shared/convention-applicability-rules.md before including a convention — inapplicable conventions are excluded entirely (not listed with 'Not applicable' annotations), and applicable ones include a rationale in the prescribed format ('Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>'), not free-form prose
assertion_results.evidence: All convention references in Implementation Notes use the prescribed format. Examples from Task 1: 'Per CONVENTIONS.md §Error handling: ... Applies: task modifies `modules/search/src/service/mod.rs` matching the convention's Rust handler scope.' Task 2: 'Per CONVENTIONS.md §Module pattern: ... Applies: task creates `modules/search/src/model/mod.rs` matching the convention's module structure scope.' Task 3: 'Per CONVENTIONS.md §Testing: ... Applies: task modifies `tests/api/search.rs` matching the convention's test file scope.' No conventions are listed with 'Not applicable' annotations. All rationales follow the 'Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>' pattern.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9002 has Priority: Normal. Impact map states: '**Priority:** Normal (inherited from TC-9002; will be propagated to all created tasks and epics)'. Summary-comment.md states: '**Priority:** Normal (from TC-9002) -- propagated to all created tasks and epics via `additional_fields.priority`'.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9002 has Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.6.0. CLAUDE.md has no ### Jira Field Defaults section, so scope defaults to 'both'. Impact map states: '**Fix Versions:** RHTPA 1.6.0 (inherited from TC-9002; will be propagated to all created tasks and epics -- fixVersion scope defaults to "both" since no Jira Field Defaults section exists)'. Summary-comment.md states: '**Fix Versions:** RHTPA 1.6.0 (from TC-9002) -- propagated to all created tasks and epics via `additional_fields.fixVersions` (fixVersion scope defaults to "both" since no Jira Field Defaults section is configured)'.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md exists in the outputs directory and contains '## Inherited Field Values Propagated' section with: 'Priority: Normal (from TC-9002) -- propagated to all created tasks and epics via additional_fields.priority' and 'Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.6.0 (from TC-9002) -- propagated to all created tasks and epics via additional_fields.fixVersions'. The impact map also contains '## Inherited Field Values' with the same information.
